### 1 — Scene
A snack-style assortment: golden-brown slices that appear to be tofu, two small savory balls, and two cereal/granola bars. Food identification is somewhat uncertain from the photo.

### 2 — Vessel
A round dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** in diameter.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
- Golden-brown tofu-like slices, in two groups
- Two small savory balls, possibly vegetable or meat-based
- One cereal bar with chocolate drizzle
- One cereal/nut bar with chocolate pieces and a chocolate base

No separate sauce or dressing is visible. Any cooking oil or chocolate is included in the corresponding food’s energy estimate.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Heights represent average thickness across each item's footprint, rather than its tallest point.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Tofu-like slices | 17% | 90.3 cm² × 2.5 cm = 226 ml | 0.9 g/ml | 203 g | 190 | 386 kcal |
| Two savory balls | 6% | 31.9 cm² × 1.8 cm = 57 ml | 0.85 g/ml | 49 g | 220 | 108 kcal |
| Chocolate-drizzled cereal bar | 7% | 37.2 cm² × 1.1 cm = 41 ml | 0.75 g/ml | 31 g | 440 | 136 kcal |
| Chocolate cereal/nut bar | 7% | 37.2 cm² × 1.1 cm = 41 ml | 0.75 g/ml | 31 g | 470 | 146 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 17% + 6% + 7% + 7% = **37%**, consistent with the substantial exposed plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **314 g and approximately 776 kcal**. That is plausible for several thick tofu slices, two bite-sized balls, and two energy-dense bars. The largest uncertainty is the identity and preparation of the golden slices.
